query_concept: prediction or price changes future demand distribution; Markov feedback; robust performative optimization
inclusion_rule: formal decision-dependent distribution or feedback learning
exclusion_rule: ordinary concept drift with no action-to-distribution link
decision: strong conceptual direction but generic theory is mature; EV novelty must be in response identification, closed-loop stability and grid risk

query_concept: randomized tariffs, dynamic prices, managed charging, shadow peaks, substitution
inclusion_rule: field experiment or explicit intervention evidence
decision: action-conditioned demand is real and material; public microdata remain the principal bottleneck

query_concept: new station expansion, demand redistribution, demand-supply coupling, iterative forecast-optimize
sources_prioritized: Transportation Research A/D, Applied Energy, INL
inclusion_rule: new infrastructure explicitly changes demand or user behavior
decision: new-station forecasting alone is occupied; support-aware structural OOD under demand redistribution remains possible

query_concept: inverse optimization, revealed preference, bid curve, behavioral inverse modelling
sources_prioritized: Computers & Operations Research, Scientific Reports, official code
inclusion_rule: learn latent objective/feasible-set/behavior parameters from observed charging
decision: inverse learning is established; only partial-identification under aggregate controlled data and policy shift could be novel

query_concept: queue, availability, balking, reneging, station substitution, rejected demand
sources_prioritized: IEEE, Transportation Research, arXiv frontier, open tools
inclusion_rule: capacity/service process alters observed charging demand
exclusion_rule: energy forecast with no service mechanism
decision: high-value problem, but real queue/abandonment/substitution labels are scarce; retain as data-gated route

query_concept: heavy-duty truck routes, bus timetable, energy prediction, depot charging, disruption uncertainty
sources_prioritized: Applied Energy, npj Sustainable Mobility and Transport, Zenodo, GitHub
inclusion_rule: mobility operations explicitly generate charging demand
decision: strong practical alternative with accessible data/code; novelty should target probabilistic disruptions and risk-limiting scheduling

query_concept: behavioral uncertainty, peak/load fluctuation, rare fast-charging patterns, tail risk
sources_prioritized: Nature Communications, Applied Energy, grid-risk literature
inclusion_rule: behavior uncertainty linked to peak or grid consequence
decision: tail risk is an important objective/module but not a standalone direction without event labels and downstream consequence

query_concept: cost-aware agents, adaptive charging, price elasticity, causal graph, route choice
sources_prioritized: Transportation Research D, Pattern Recognition Letters
exclusion_rule: price only appended as a feature
decision: ordinary price-aware forecasting is crowded; performative or counterfactual validity is required
